segments.text: Imma be honest with you, pretty much anything that can harm a human or the environment makes
segments.zh: 跟你说实话，几乎任何能伤害人类或环境的东西

segments.text: its way into a lab.
segments.zh: 都会出现在实验室里。

segments.text: So is your standards that are relevant to your work could very well cover the whole
segments.zh: 所以与你工作相关的 OSHA 标准，很可能涵盖整个

segments.text: gambit, from air contaminants to extremes of temperature.
segments.zh: 范围，从空气污染物到极端温度。

segments.text: This training isn't meant to deep dive into each of these, we've got other courses
segments.zh: 这次培训并不打算深入讲解每一项，我们有其他课程

segments.text: for that.
segments.zh: 专门讲这些。

segments.text: But there are a few heavy hitting points I've just got to get across to you.
segments.zh: 但有几个重点我必须要跟你讲清楚。
第一。

segments.text: You have the right to know what you're being exposed to in any work environment.
segments.zh: 在任何工作环境中，你都有权知道自己接触的是什么。

segments.text: Heavy Data Sheets will be your go-to resource for understanding what known hazards you'll
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书将是你了解化学品暴露方面会面临哪些已知危害的

segments.text: be facing in terms of chemical exposure.
segments.zh: 首选资料。

segments.text: This can range from simple cleaning materials to hazardous waste.
segments.zh: 范围可以从简单的清洁用品一直到危险废物。

segments.text: You'll want to be thinking about the health, physical and environmental hazards of anything
segments.zh: 你要考虑你所使用的任何东西的健康危害、物理危害和

segments.text: you're working with.
segments.zh: 环境危害。
第二。

segments.text: Despite being at the bottom of the inverted hierarchy of controls pyramid, that PPE has
segments.zh: 尽管 PPE 位于倒金字塔形控制层级的最底部，但它

segments.text: got to be maintained and worn properly.
segments.zh: 必须得到维护并正确穿戴。

segments.text: It's the employer's job to supply all PPE required for known hazards, but it's your
segments.zh: 为已知危害提供所有必需的 PPE 是雇主的职责，但你的

segments.text: job to wear it right, keep it clean and functioning, and communicate if something's not quite
segments.zh: 职责是正确穿戴，保持清洁和功能正常，如果有什么地方不太

segments.text: right or needs to be replaced.
segments.zh: 对劲或需要更换，要及时沟通。

segments.text: Speaking of communication, Hazcom, short for hazard communication, has got to become
segments.zh: 说到沟通，Hazcom，也就是危害沟通的简称，必须变得

segments.text: like a second language to you.
segments.zh: 像你的第二语言一样。

segments.text: The safety data sheets are part of this, but the nuts and bolts include properly labeling
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书是其中的一部分，但核心内容包括正确地给容器贴标签，

segments.text: and, when needed, relabeling, containers to identify chemicals and hazards.
segments.zh: 必要时重新贴标签，以标明化学品和危害。

segments.text: Developing and maintaining a written hazard communication plan, reading placards, and overall,
segments.zh: 制定并维护书面的危害沟通计划，阅读标牌，总的来说，

segments.text: you gotta know how to interpret product identifiers, pictograms, signal words, a slew of stuff.
segments.zh: 你得知道如何解读产品标识、象形图、信号词，一大堆东西。

segments.text: Like I said, we've got more detailed training to help you get into the weeds on this stuff,
segments.zh: 就像我说的，我们有更详细的培训帮你深入了解这些内容，

segments.text: but for now, what you gotta realize is, hazards are everywhere.
segments.zh: 但现在你要认识到的是，危害无处不在。

segments.text: They depend on the type of work you're doing and they're foreseeable, meaning
segments.zh: 它们取决于你所做的工作类型，而且是可以预见的，这意味着

segments.text: you can prepare for them.
segments.zh: 你可以为它们做好准备。

segments.text: Handling hazardous materials?
segments.zh: 处理危险材料？

segments.text: Select the right gloves.
segments.zh: 选择合适的手套。

segments.text: Noxious fumes involved?
segments.zh: 涉及有害烟气？

segments.text: Choose the appropriate respirator.
segments.zh: 选择合适的呼吸器。

segments.text: Hazmat situation?
segments.zh: 遇到危险品情况？

segments.text: Suit up.
segments.zh: 穿上防护服。

segments.text: No, put that tux down, fool.
segments.zh: 不，把那套燕尾服放下，傻瓜。

segments.text: I mean, don scrub suits, coveralls, and other gear.
segments.zh: 我是说穿上刷手服、连体工作服和其他装备。

segments.text: Alright, great.
segments.zh: 好了，很好。

segments.text: You're all suited up.
segments.zh: 你全副武装了。

segments.text: What could possibly go wrong?
segments.zh: 还能出什么问题呢？

segments.text: You know, that's a good question.
segments.zh: 你知道，这是个好问题。

segments.text: Let's see.
segments.zh: 我们来看看。

segments.text: You're surrounded by chemical hazards, like acids and flammable materials.
segments.zh: 你周围都是化学危害，比如酸和易燃材料。

segments.text: Biological hazards, like blood-borne pathogens, bites or stings from animals, insects,
segments.zh: 生物危害，比如血源性病原体，实验室里动物、昆虫，

segments.text: or even humans in the lab.
segments.zh: 甚至人的咬伤或蜇伤。

segments.text: Physical hazards, like poor ergonomics.
segments.zh: 物理危害，比如不良的人体工学。

segments.text: Ouch, my back!
segments.zh: 哎哟，我的背！

segments.text: Said every lab rat ever, eventually.
segments.zh: 每个实验室小白鼠迟早都会这么说。

segments.text: And of course, general safety hazards, like cryogenics, open flames, situations requiring
segments.zh: 当然还有一般安全危害，比如低温、明火、维护时需要执行

segments.text: lockout-tagout procedures for maintenance, you know, the list just goes on.
segments.zh: 上锁挂牌程序的情况，你知道，这个清单还可以一直列下去。

segments.text: Depending on your work, you may even be dealing with radioactive materials.
segments.zh: 根据你的工作，你甚至可能要接触放射性材料。

segments.text: Bottom line, look before you leap.
segments.zh: 总而言之，三思而后行。
